transcript: Speaker A: స్పోకెన్ ఇంగ్లీష్ నేర్చుకోవడం ఇప్పుడు చాలా సులభమైంది. నమస్కారం. ఇంగ్లీష్ ను కాన్ఫిడెంట్ గా మాట్లాడాలనుకుని కానీ ఎక్కడి నుంచి మొదలు పెట్టాలో తెలియని ప్రతి ఒక్కరికీ ఇది ఒక ముఖ్యమైన అప్డేట్. SpeakX యాప్ ను డౌన్లోడ్ చేసుకొని ఈరోజే మీ ట్రయాల్ ను ప్రారంభించండి. [Learning spoken English is now very easy. Hello. This is an important update for everyone who wants to speak English confidently but doesn't know where to start. A new AI-based platform called SpeakX is now helping people learn spoken English in a very simple and practical way. In this app, users have short and easy lessons. Through them, you can learn what to speak, how to speak, and how to speak more naturally in real-life situations. The main attraction in this is an AI English mentor named SIA. SIA is available 24/7. So users can practice speaking anytime. If you make mistakes while speaking, SIA will immediately correct them and help you improve step-by-step. You can practice as many times as you want without any hesitation. With just a few minutes of practice every day, many users are already improving their spoken English. So if you also want to look more confident when speaking English, this is the right time to start practicing. Download the SpeakX app and start your trial today.]
